full.rationale: Rebaselined 2026-07-31 after the competitor-gap release. The 1.3.6-rc1 reference predates a large batch of shipped capability: metadata strip extended to WebP/SVG/HEIC/AVIF plus C2PA removal, XMP/DDS/gain-map facts in Image info, EXIF-IPTC-XMP carry-through on Convert and Resize, PDF page layouts, ComicInfo.xml in CBZ, pad-to-canvas resize, multi-size batch output, WOFF font previews, the eyedropper stash, and HDR screen capture. That is a deliberate +253 KiB installer / +922 KiB Rust payload, reviewed and accepted, not drift. The HDR capture stack (D3D11/DXGI/WinRT Graphics.Capture) is behind the APP-ONLY `hdr-capture` cargo feature precisely so the shell DLL does not pay for it; verified by `objdump -p`, which shows d3d11.dll and dxgi.dll imported by SageThumbs2K.exe and by NEITHER sagethumbs2k.dll nor st2k.exe. Keep later releases within 128 KiB compressed and 256 KiB for each raw payload unless an explicit reviewed policy change records why.

ARM64 FULL, text-stack STUBBED, recalibrated 2026-08-02. ARM64 bundles the same pinned ImageMagick 7.1.2-29 Q16-HDRI release as x64 (packaging/imagemagick-source-arm64.json) and now also stubs the text-shaping stack the way x64 does, so the two architectures are at parity: magick payload 29217728 bytes here against x64's 29,827,612. Installer 12146914 bytes, SHA-256 bfed8d336c8ee82fc6043bd9ae4b4274596c4d804fa385c9a726fd709d2168f2. The stubs are built with the MSVC ARM64 toolchain (cl + link /DEF /IMPLIB) rather than MinGW, because MinGW emits x86_64 PEs regardless of target - the first ARM64 Full build silently replaced genuine ARM64 DLLs with x64 stubs, which an ARM64 loader refuses. gendef still extracts the exports for both architectures, since a PE export table is architecture-independent. link's /IMPLIB is load-bearing: without it the linker drops <name>.lib and <name>.exp beside /OUT, straight into the shipped bundle. harfbuzz and fribidi end up fully pruned once stubbing removes their importers, which is why the file count is 155. Every staged PE is asserted to be machine 0xAA64. NOTE: published 1.6.0 shipped the UNSTUBBED arm64 payload (13,589,408-byte installer); this reference applies from the next release.
